title: Fearing winter polls, Ladakh political parties, social bodies plan protests

ai.summary: Political parties and civil society groups in Ladakh plan protests to delay Hill Council elections due to winter migration, citing 20-25% of residents leaving the region during cold season.

facts.claim: 20-25% of Ladakh’s population migrates outside the region during winter
facts.quote: Flanked by Ladakh MP Mohmad Haneefa and other political and religious leaders, Kargili said 20% to 25% of Ladakh’s population, particularly elderly people, students and members of the business community, migrates outside the region during winter.

facts.claim: Political parties and civil society groups in Ladakh plan protests to delay Hill Council elections
facts.quote: In Kargil, political parties and religious and social organisations called for a complete shutdown on Tuesday and a candlelight march in the evening, demanding deferment of the elections.

ai.background_note: Ladakh lost statehood in 2019, becoming a union territory. The movement seeks restoration of statehood, but this article focuses on protests against winter elections that could disenfranchise migrants.
